texto: In the pharmacy, the most natural and respectful formula for ordering a product is the courtesy conditional: **Vorrei una crema per le scottature** (I would like a burn cream); **Vorrei uno sciroppo per la tosse** (I would like a cough syrup). Avoid the direct imperative * dammi * or the tajante * voglio *.

The pharmacist will indicate the dose with temporary expressions: **una volta al giorno** (once daily), **due volte al dì / al giorno** (twice daily), **a stomaco pieno** (after eating), **prima dei pasti** (before meals).

filas: Prescripción oficial expedida por el facultativo

bloques.titulo: To the bank of the pharmacy

frases.it: Buongiorno, signor Luca! Desidera qualcosa in particolare?
frases.es: ¡Buenos días, señor Luca! ¿Desea algo en particular?
frases.en: Good morning, Mr. Luca! Do you want anything in particular?

frases.it: Buongiorno. Vorrei una crema lenitiva per un dolore muscolare al braccio.
frases.es: Buenos días. Quisiera una crema calmante para un dolor muscular en el brazo.
frases.en: Good morning. I'd like a soothing cream for a muscle pain in the arm.

frases.it: Certamente: applichi questa pomata due volte al giorno con un massaggio leggero.
frases.es: Por supuesto: aplique esta pomada dos veces al día con un ligero masaje.
frases.en: Of course: apply this ointment twice a day with a light massage.

frases.it: Serve la ricetta medica per questo prodotto?
frases.es: ¿Hace falta receta médica para este producto?
frases.en: Do you need a prescription for this product?

frases.it: No, per questa crema non serve: costa nove euro e cinquanta.
frases.es: No, para esta crema no hace falta: cuesta nueve euros con cincuenta.
frases.en: No, it's not necessary for this cream: it costs nine euros with fifty.

bloques.pregunta: How is a product being asked for in an educational way when entering a pharmacy?

opciones.texto: Vorrei una crema per il dolore alla schiena.
opciones.explicacion: «Vorrei» is the canonical courtesy formula for commercial and sanitary requests.

opciones.texto: Ho una crema per il dolore alla schiena.
opciones.explicacion: It means you already have the cream in your power.

opciones.texto: Voglio che mi dai una crema adesso.
opciones.explicacion: I turn rude and unfriendly in professional treatment.

bloques.pregunta: What does the dose indication «due volte al giorno» mean?

opciones.texto: Take or apply the product twice each day.
opciones.explicacion: «Due volte al giorno» specifies the daily frequency of the take.

opciones.texto: Take the medication only for two days in total.
opciones.explicacion: It would confuse daily frequency with the duration of treatment.

opciones.texto: Repeat the dose every other week.
opciones.explicacion: It alludes to a daily periodicity.

bloques.frase: Ho un forte mal di gola: vorrei uno ___ per la tosse, per favore.

opciones.explicacion: «Sciroppo» is the Italian noun for syrup and adopts the article «uno».
Plural substance that does not match singular masculine «uno».

bloques.pregunta: When should the prescribed pills be ingested?
bloques.frase: Prenda queste pastiglie dopo i pasti principali della giornata.

opciones.explicacion: «Dopo i pasti principali» places the take after the major meals.

opciones.texto: In severe fasting before getting up in the morning.
opciones.explicacion: It expressly points out that it must be after meals.

opciones.texto: Just midnight in the middle of the night break.
opciones.explicacion: Prescribes the take coordinated with the meals of the day.

bloques.pregunta: What document requires the drug to be dispensed?
bloques.frase: Il medico ha prescritto un antibiotico: serve la ricetta in farmacia.

opciones.texto: The medical prescription signed by the doctor.
opciones.explicacion: Antibiotics require an official prescription at the pharmacy.
It is not related to health procedures.

opciones.texto: La tarjeta bancaria de crédito internacional.
opciones.explicacion: The essential health requirement is the medical prescription.

bloques.frase: Vorrei una crema per il dolore muscolare
bloques.traduccion: I'd like a muscle pain cream.

bloques.pregunta: What is the plural form of the masculine «il cerotto» noun?

opciones.explicacion: feminine non-existent termination for this word.
It does not keep the invariable form in plural.

intro: Learn to apply for medicines and medical products at the pharmacy by means of the «vorrei» courtesy.
